name: s10-cpp-enum-unscoped-and-casts
description: Unscoped enums convert to integer like in C++ (arithmetic, bitwise operators, comparison with integers); casts integer -> enum and enum -> integer; an enum value without enumerator is written motor::Mode(7).
text: A -> A : fail / flags = flags | io::kOverCurrent | valueof(fail); level = (flags & 3) as io::Level; raw = level as integer + io::kStall

flags.h: enum ErrorFlags : unsigned { kNone = 0, kOverCurrent = 1u << 0, kOverTemperature = 1u << 1, kStall = 1u << 2 };
enum class Level : int { Low = 1, High = 3 };
